subject: general
question: A video or photo experiencing a sudden spike in popularity in a short period of time is termed as ____.
solution:
The correct answer is option **2** i.e __**Viral.**__

 
• A video or photo experiencing a sudden spike in popularity in a short period of time is termed as viral.
 
 
• A video is said to be viral, when it becomes popular through a process of Internet sharing, typically through video sharing websites such as YouTube, Facebook, Twitter as well as other
